data.name: Arjani
data.gender_notes: Arjani is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arjani is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arjana', meaning 'exalted' or 'respected'. This name has rich historical significance in Hindu mythology as the name of several revered figures, including Arjuna, the great warrior of the Mahabharata epic. The name Arjani carries the meaning “Exalted, Respected” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjani usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, respected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies respect and honor in the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Arjani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Respected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjani total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
